before flood test or finish application Download ExcelDownload PDF **6** Checkpoints **3** Sections During application (if possible) and post-cure; minimum 5 tests per 100m² QC Engineer, Waterproofing Contractor [IS 2645:1974](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2645-2003) Related [📐IS 2645](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2645) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Concrete Mix Ratios](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-mix-ratios) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧water-demand-lpcd-calculator](https://infralens.in/tools/water-demand-lpcd-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. TEST PROCEDURE | | A1 | DFT (Dry Film Thickness) measured with electronic gauge; typical tolerance ±25 microns
Acceptance: Gauge calibrated; substrate and film thickness measured; difference = DFT | Cl. 402 — Measurement method | | | B. TEST RESULTS | | B1 | Test point 1: DFT measured (microns); location documented
Acceptance: Typical spec: 1.5-3.0mm DFT for single/double coat liquid membranes | Cl. 402 — Individual reading | | | B2 | Test point 2-5: DFT measured at different locations; variations noted
Acceptance: 5 test points minimum per 100m²; readings distributed across area; corner/edge samples required | Cl. 402 — Multiple readings | | | B3 | Average DFT calculated; minimum and maximum values recorded; variation noted
Acceptance: Average should meet or exceed spec; variation <±20% from average; consistency indicator | Cl. 402 — Statistical summary | | | C. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA | | C1 | DFT compliance: Average measured DFT ≥ specification minimum (typically 1.5mm for single-coat)
Acceptance: Single-coat min: 1.5mm; two-coat min: 2.5-3.0mm; all points ≥85% of average acceptable | Cl. 402 — Thickness acceptance | | | C2 | Uniformity: No point more than ±20% below average; indicates consistent application
Acceptance: Variation ≤±20% from average = PASS; >±20% = thin spots requiring re-coat; re-test after touch-up | Cl. 402 — Application quality | | A.
